scope.universe: all atlas_packets with a packet summary, a 2026-07-04 gemma4_offline layer row, same-ref July-era chunk summary, or a non-placeholder embedding

placeholderRule: embedding vector shared by >1% of all embedded packets
notProven: exact writer of atlas_packets.summary for these rows
that embeddings were generated from these summaries (no embedding-input record found in row data)

findings.realEmbeddingsAlignWithPacketSummaries: All 6,883 packets holding a non-placeholder embedding (globally, of 61,659 embedded) have a packet summary (0 real embeddings without a summary). This is the strongest link found: real vector <=> summary-bearing packet.
findings.july4LayerCoverage: Only 3,058 of those 6,883 (44%) are in the 2026-07-04 gemma4_offline layer; 3,825 got summaries from another source. Of 3,060 July-4 layer packets, packet.summary equals the layer text on only 388.
findings.embeddingRunDate: embedding_timestamp is 2026-07-20 (4,463 real, 3,196 placeholder) and 2026-07-21 (2,420 real, 6 placeholder): embeddings came from a run about 16 days AFTER the July-4 summaries, and placeholders came from the SAME run (fallback path), not a later one.
findings.placeholderPath: 3,200 placeholder-embedding packets in this universe carry only July-era chunk summaries (chunk_summaries>0, no packet summary): the packet embedding step saw no packet summary and stored the shared vector while chunk summaries existed on the same source_ref, never propagated.
findings.flagsUnreliable: embedding_eligible=false on every embedded packet (real and placeholder), embedding_digest absent everywhere, packet.summary_hash null on all; none of them can distinguish real from placeholder.
findings.revision: Of 10,086 manifest packets, 3,635 carry a source_revision equal to the current cohort revision; 6,451 have no revision. 0 stale, 0 conflicting.
findings.goRetrieval: go-retrieval-classifier (hybrid.go) reads atlas_packets.summary via Postgres full-text at query time; no separate summary export/index artifact found. The 8100 retrieval facade source was not located in this pass.

hypothesisUpdate: Real embeddings were built on 2026-07-20/21 from the packet summary text present then; placeholders are that same run's fallback for packets without a packet summary. Still unproven: the embedding input text (no record), and the writer of atlas_packets.summary.
